ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_advantage_gap_sum_loss
ir.intuition: This loss leverages the same pairwise advantage gap principle but aggregates the weighted log-sigmoid terms by summation instead of averaging. Summation can preserve total magnitude information and may emphasize batch size effects while retaining the original pairwise margin structure.
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    log_prob_w = batch['log_prob_w']
    log_prob_l = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    scaled_diff = ops.mul(advantage_gap, ops.sub(log_prob_w, log_prob_l))
    loss_terms = ops.logsigmoid(scaled_diff)
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_terms, weight)
    return ops.sum(weighted_loss)
